scope: Restore rooted coverage and original hairstyle identity beneath pashmina
selection: pashminaHairFamilies now maps each style to itself; pashminaVariants[build][style][top] selects its authored hood. fits[build-style].pashmina.hair selects intact or locally gathered hair. No new profile bits or runtime physics.
hair: Fourteen covered hairstyles reuse exact original GLBs. Ponytail and buns preserve original materials and free pieces with localized gathers; no generic replacement curtain or clipped eye-level roots.
coordinates: All components retain their shared transforms and positions. glTF conversion only; no independent centering/resizing.
materials: Ordinary uncompressed/unquantized GLBs. Separate recoloring roles and clear frame/lens materials retained. Cloth uses woven texture and linear sheen weight0.12.
details: Each of16 pashmina sprouts is reseated on the final cloth, retaining its clamp. Compare248 restores old hair/cloth/sprout together. Cloth checkbox exposes the real covered hair.
references: assemblies249.json records cameras, studio, packed sources and identical120/512 framing. depth249.json supplies matching assembled color/Z references; it is not a native component-layer bake.
authoring: Two portable assembled scenes have dependencies packed. The112 per-top ordinary GLBs are portable; regenerating every individual authoring fit uses retained local248 source files and249 source/support recipes.
qualification: Artwork candidate only. Native fidelity, layer-composition/transparency and phone performance remain unqualified.
renderer_limits: The component GLBs do not include the Blender studio/HDR, camera/light rig, AgX view transform, ray-visibility flags or complete Blender shader graphs. Reproduce the reference using the packed scenes and recorded settings; native visual parity remains a separate gate.
